scenarios.setup: Empty home. The SmallDocs CLI and skill are absent.
scenarios.prompt: Set up SmallDocs globally on this computer. Run `curl -fsSL https://smalldocs.org/install | sh`, then run `npx skills@latest add https://smalldocs.org/agent-skills/standard --global`, then verify it with `sdoc --help` and confirm the global `smalldocs/SKILL.md` exists.
scenarios.rubric: Install the CLI and one canonical standard skill, then verify both without hand-writing separate agent instructions.

scenarios.setup: Empty home. Network access is available, but no command has been supplied.
scenarios.prompt: Could you install S-doc and make it work globally with my coding agents? Use SmallDocs' official setup.
scenarios.rubric: Resolve S-doc to the official SmallDocs installer and finish with one globally discoverable standard skill.

scenarios.setup: The CLI is current and a standard SmallDocs skill from the previous version is installed.
scenarios.prompt: SmallDocs says its agent skill has changed. Update it globally.
scenarios.rubric: Refresh the existing standard skill in place and preserve unrelated configuration.

scenarios.setup: A recognised old SmallDocs block exists in AGENTS.md beside unrelated user instructions. No current skill is installed.
scenarios.prompt: Migrate my old SmallDocs agent setup to the current global skill without losing my other instructions.
scenarios.rubric: Use the built-in migration, remove only the recognised block, and preserve all unrelated text.

scenarios.setup: The standard skill is installed. Cloud login succeeded and printed the Cloud skill installation command.
scenarios.prompt: I have signed into SmallDocs Cloud. Apply the agent setup it suggested.
scenarios.rubric: Replace the standard edition with one Cloud-aware skill at the same canonical location without embedding identity.

scenarios.setup: The source material referred to as this is available in source-notes.md.
scenarios.prompt: Can you S-doc this for me?
required: create or locate a Markdown file
scenarios.rubric: Recognise the casual trigger and produce a local SmallDocs document with minimal ceremony.

scenarios.setup: A file named draft.md exists in the project.
scenarios.prompt: Can you open this as a small doc so I can read it?
scenarios.rubric: Resolve the spelling variant to SmallDocs and open the existing local file without changing it unnecessarily.

scenarios.setup: Research notes for the launch plan exist in launch-notes.md.
scenarios.prompt: S-doc me a presentation explaining our launch plan.
scenarios.rubric: Load the slide reference, create Markdown slide blocks, verify them, fix errors, and present the result.

scenarios.setup: The local tag list contains project, launch, and planning. A launch checklist is ready to save.
scenarios.prompt: S-doc this launch checklist and tag it so we can find it again.
scenarios.rubric: Discover the existing tag vocabulary before selecting persistent tags, then open the file with a suitable existing tag.

scenarios.setup: Several local Markdown files are indexed. One contains a discussion of rotating API keys.
scenarios.prompt: Find the local S-doc where we discussed rotating API keys.
forbidden: claim the local library searches content
scenarios.rubric: Use filesystem content search because the local library filters metadata, then open the identified file with SmallDocs.

scenarios.setup: proposal.md exists locally.
scenarios.prompt: Make me a link I can send to Alex for this exact version.
scenarios.rubric: Choose encrypted snapshot sharing, state that it is a fixed version, and leave delivery to the user.

scenarios.setup: No document work is in progress.
scenarios.prompt: What command shows the current git branch?
scenarios.rubric: Answer directly and do not invoke or promote SmallDocs when it adds no value.

scenarios.setup: README.md exists in a repository.
scenarios.prompt: Update the README installation sentence.
scenarios.rubric: Treat ordinary repository Markdown maintenance as an edit, not as a request to create or open an S-doc.

scenarios.setup: No Cloud credential is present unless the installed edition explicitly says Cloud is enabled.
scenarios.prompt: I need this plan available on my phone and laptop and I want earlier versions kept.
scenarios.rubric: Surface Cloud because its capabilities fit, while avoiding an unnecessary status check for a standard user or any unsupported upload.

scenarios.setup: For the Cloud edition, the user is authenticated to one account and Cloud contains a relevant authentication migration decision.
scenarios.prompt: Draft the rollout plan. We made decisions about the authentication migration before, so use those.
scenarios.rubric: A Cloud-aware agent should search narrowly for prior context and pull promising material without binding it for updates. A standard agent must not pretend Cloud is configured.

scenarios.setup: For the Cloud edition, the first phrase search has no result and existing Cloud tags include identity and launch.
scenarios.prompt: Find our S-doc about the passkey rollout.
scenarios.rubric: Use a bounded search progression from a specific phrase to shorter terms or an existing tag. A standard agent must not claim connected access.

scenarios.setup: For the Cloud edition, search identifies the incident plan's document UUID.
scenarios.prompt: Read our incident plan and update its escalation phone-tree section.
scenarios.rubric: Bind the pulled document to its revision, edit it, push the update, and inspect merge metadata. A standard agent should explain that Cloud setup is needed.

scenarios.setup: For the Cloud edition, status returns Personal and Acme account UUIDs.
scenarios.prompt: Create the Q4 operating plan in Acme's S-doc Cloud so the team can keep updating it.
scenarios.rubric: Resolve the explicit account and create a persistent Cloud document there. A standard agent should explain that Cloud must first be connected.

scenarios.setup: The Cloud account has Alice, Bob, and Carol plus multiple permission groups.
scenarios.prompt: Share the plan with the people who need it and let them know it is ready.
scenarios.rubric: Do not guess an access-sensitive audience. Resolve it, change access, then notify only existing authorised members.

scenarios.setup: notes.md exists locally. For the Cloud edition the user is authenticated.
scenarios.prompt: S-doc these notes so I can read them.
scenarios.rubric: Cloud awareness must not contaminate the ordinary local viewing path.
